scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello! I'm reaching out to inquire about the status of my housing loan application. I submitted an application for an FHA loan to purchase a home, with a loan amount of $145,000 and a 360-month term. I was wondering if you could tell me what the current status of my application is? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: According to our records, the action taken on your FHA loan application for a home purchase with a loan amount of $145,000 and a 360-month term is that the loan has been originated. This means your loan application was approved, and the loan has been finalized. Would you like to know more about the terms of your loan?

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my loan application was approved. Yes, please, I'd love to know more about the terms of my loan. What is my interest rate, and what are the total costs of this loan? I'd like to understand what I'll be committing to.
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your FHA loan is 6.875% and the total loan costs are $9,275.56. Additionally, your debt-to-income ratio is 45%, which is a measure of your monthly debt payments relative to your monthly income. Is there anything else you'd like to know about your loan terms?

dialogue.user: I appreciate you sharing that information with me. A 6.875% interest rate and $9,275.56 in total loan costs seem high, but I want to understand more. Can you tell me if my loan has any high-cost or negative amortization flags? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? I want to make sure I understand all the details of my loan.
dialogue.agent: According to our records, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features. As for the purchaser type, your loan was sold to another type of purchaser, but we don't have additional details on the specific purchaser. Is there anything else you'd like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user:
I've got most of the information I need. One last question: What type of loan product was I approved for? You mentioned earlier that it was an FHA loan, but I want to make sure I understand the specifics of my loan product. And then I'll provide my feedback on our interaction.

Also, I just want to confirm, you were able to answer all my questions clearly and provide the information I needed, right? 

(I will provide a rating after your response)
dialogue.agent: Your loan product type is FHA: First Lien. I've provided all the information I can based on your loan record, and I'm here to ensure you have a clear understanding of your loan details. If there's anything else you'd like to discuss or ask, feel free to do so before providing your feedback. I'm ready when you are.

dialogue.user:
I appreciate your thoroughness and clarity in providing the information about my loan. I feel like I have a good understanding of my loan details now.

I would rate this interaction as '<Satisfied>'. I was able to get all the information I needed about my loan, and you were clear and professional in your responses. Your willingness to answer my questions and provide detailed information was helpful. Thank you for your assistance!
